portfolio.statement: Edelweiss Small Cap Fund holds 98.1% in equities across 7,000 Cr AUM, balancing cyclical Industrials and Financials (20.8% each) against Consumer Discretionary (17.2%) and Healthcare (15.3%).
interp: Strong performance from industrial order flows and capital-market beneficiaries drove positive contributions, led by Engineers India (+0.301%) and Avalon Technologies (+0.291%).
Healthcare holdings formed the largest drag on performance over the trailing 3 months, led by Fortis Healthcare (-0.393% contribution) and KIMS (-0.270% contribution).
portfolio.line: Industrial and exchange gains offset severe healthcare drawdowns, leaving 3-month performance at -3.98%.

drivers.text: Engineers India won an overseas refinery PMC contract exceeding US$450 million, returning 15.58% over 3 months.
KIMS suffered a sustained margin and net profit contraction down to Rs 37 crore in Q1 FY27, dragging returns down 14.46% over 3 months.
Karur Vysya Bank expanded margins and initiated a 20 bps MCLR hike while targeting 18-20% credit growth.
